definitions.explanation: The flow of liquid, gas, or other substances in the opposite direction from normal. Can be literal (water flowing upstream) or figurative (a reversal of trends).

examples.japanese: ⟦{下水|げすい}→下水：00069_gesui⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{逆流|ぎゃくりゅう}⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
⟦{大雨|おおあめ}→大雨：03015_ooame⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{川|かわ}→川：02186_kawa⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{水|みず}→水：02258_mizu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{逆流|ぎゃくりゅう}⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: The river water flowed backward due to heavy rain.

examples.japanese: ⟦{時代|じだい}→時代：01424_jidai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{流|なが}れ→流れ：03504_nagare⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{逆流|ぎゃくりゅう}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ような⟦{政策|せいさく}→政策：10070_seisaku⟧だ⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{批判|ひはん}→批判：03580_hihan⟧⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: The policy was criticized as going against the flow of the times.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{逆|ぎゃく}→逆：02649_gyaku⟧ (reverse, opposite) + {流|りゅう} (flow, current). Used as both a noun and a ⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ verb. Common in contexts involving plumbing, natural disasters, medicine (acid reflux), and figurative descriptions of going against trends.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {逆流|ぎゃくりゅう}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to flow backward
- {逆流|ぎゃくりゅう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{防|ふせ}ぐ→防ぐ：02409_fusegu⟧: to prevent backflow
- {胃酸|いさん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{逆流|ぎゃくりゅう}: acid reflux (stomach acid flowing back up)
- {逆流|ぎゃくりゅう}⟦{防止|ぼうし}→防止：14571_boushi⟧: backflow prevention

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {還流|かんりゅう}: reflux, return flow (technical/scientific term)
- ⟦{氾濫|はんらん}→氾濫：09256_hanran⟧: flooding, overflow (water exceeding its banks, not necessarily reversing)
